svg.text: 2026-10-15 · 2.54 mm perfboard, 40 × 26 holes (102 × 66 mm) · front end + touch stage laid out; modules and Pro Micro by label
parts, insulated jumpers (arcs); bottom wiring ghosted; teal rings = a wire to a module / the Pro Micro
upright, USB to the top edge
bare tinned wire; grey = a part's lead; white ring = a jumper's end; read it with the board flipped left-right
Wires to the modules and the Pro Micro (teal rings, numbered):
J1-J3: foot, top to bottom EXC+ (top gauge), mid, EXC− · J5: TOUCH, GND to the Melzi · R4/R5 completion pair
Q1: BC547 legs C-B-E with the flat face toward you; a 2N3904 is E-B-C: turn it round.
Hops: the 47 nF caps sit on the MC bus, so M1-M3 jump over it on top (insulated wire).
